flashcards.definitionZh: 一个在某件事上或某件事上有天赋的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是萨克斯管的天生演奏者。

flashcards.definition: To design a new process or mechanism.
flashcards.example: After weeks of hard work, I invented a new way to alphabetize matchbooks.
flashcards.exampleZh: 经过几周的努力，我发明了一种按字母顺序排列火柴盒的新方法。

flashcards.definition: The faculty of uttering articulate sounds or words; the ability to speak or to use vocalizations to communicate.
flashcards.example: It was hard to hear the sounds of his speech over the noise. He had a bad speech impediment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发出清晰的声音或单词的能力；说话或使用发声进行交流的能力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在喧闹声中很难听清他的讲话声。他有严重的言语障碍。

flashcards.definition: (heading) To the greatest extent or degree; completely, entirely.
flashcards.definitionZh: （标题）最大范围或程度；完全地，完全地。

flashcards.definition: The result of a contest that neither side has won; a tie.
flashcards.example: The game ended in a draw.
flashcards.definitionZh: 双方均未获胜的比赛结果；领带。

flashcards.definition: From a higher position to a lower one; downwards.
flashcards.example: The cat jumped down from the table.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较高的职位到较低的职位；向下。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: (sequence) Used to mark the beginning of the last in a list of items or propositions.
flashcards.example: Firstly, that's illegal; secondly, it has serious disadvantages; thirdly, it's not necessary; and lastly, did I mention that it's illegal?
flashcards.definitionZh: （序列）用于标记一系列项目或命题中最后一项的开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 首先，这是非法的；其次，它有严重的缺点；第三，没有必要；最后，我有没有提到这是非法的？

flashcards.definition: A demand of ownership made for something.
A professional person qualified (as by a law degree or bar exam) and authorized to practice law, i.e. represent parties in lawsuits or trials and give legal advice.
flashcards.example: A lawyer's time and advice are his stock in trade. - aphorism often credited to Abraham Lincoln, but without attestation
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有资格（如通过法律学位或律师考试）并有权执业的专业人士，即在诉讼或审判中代表当事人并提供法律建议。
flashcards.exampleZh: 律师的时间和建议是他的资本。 - 经常被认为是亚伯拉罕·林肯的格言，但未经证实

flashcards.definition: To impair the soundness, goodness, or value of; to harm or cause destruction.
flashcards.example: Be careful not to damage any of the fragile items while unpacking them.
flashcards.definitionZh: 损害以下各项的健全性、良好性或价值；伤害或造成破坏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 打开包装时小心不要损坏任何易碎物品。

flashcards.example: Important types of property include real property (land), personal property (other physical possessions), and intellectual property (rights over artistic creations, inventions, etc.).
flashcards.exampleZh: 重要的财产类型包括不动产（土地）、动产（其他实物财产）和知识产权（艺术创作、发明等的权利）。

flashcards.definition: To cause (something) to cease to be in one's possession or capability due to unfortunate or unknown circumstances, events or reasons.
flashcards.example: He lost his hearing in the explosion.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于不幸或未知的情况、事件或原因，导致某人不再拥有或无法拥有（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在爆炸中失去了听力。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: The quality or state of being young.
flashcards.example: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的青春和美丽吸引了他。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) A verb, its necessary grammatical arguments, and any adjuncts affecting them.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）动词、其必要的语法参数以及影响它们的任何修饰语。

flashcards.definition: A number of things or persons being in some relation to one another.
flashcards.example: A group of people gathered in front of the Parliament to demonstrate against the Prime Minister's proposals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 许多事物或人彼此之间存在某种关系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一群人聚集在议会前示威，反对总理的提议。

flashcards.definition: The act of joining, or condition of being joined.
flashcards.definitionZh: 加入的行为或加入的条件。

flashcards.definition: To mainly play a specific character, or side, during a game.
flashcards.example: He mains the same character as me in that game.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在游戏中主要扮演特定角色或一方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在那场比赛中扮演的角色与我相同。

flashcards.definition: One who relies on another for support
flashcards.example: With two children and an ailing mother, she had three dependents in all.
flashcards.exampleZh: 她有两个孩子和一个生病的母亲，总共有三个家属。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。

flashcards.definition: To pass from a higher to a lower place; to move downwards; to come or go down in any way, for example by falling, flowing, walking, climbing etc.
flashcards.example: The rain descended, and the floods came.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较高的地方到较低的地方；向下移动；以任何方式来或下，例如跌倒、流动、行走、攀爬等。

flashcards.definition: An instance of descending; act of coming down.
flashcards.example: We climbed the mountain with difficulty, but the descent was easier.
flashcards.definitionZh: 下降的一个例子；下来的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们爬山很困难，但下山就轻松多了。

flashcards.definition: Dedicated to a religious purpose or a god.
flashcards.example: I'm planning to visit the holy city of Jerusalem this Christmas.
flashcards.exampleZh: 我计划今年圣诞节参观圣城耶路撒冷。

flashcards.definitionZh: 耶路撒冷这个词的意思。

flashcards.definition: To admit to the truth, particularly in the context of sins or crimes committed.
flashcards.example: I confess to spray-painting all over that mural!
flashcards.definitionZh: 承认事实，特别是在犯下的罪过或犯罪的情况下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我承认那幅壁画是喷漆的！

flashcards.definition: Land adjoining a non-flowing body of water, such as an ocean, lake or pond.
flashcards.example: lake shore;  bay shore;  gulf shore;  island shore;  mainland shore;  river shore;  estuary shore;  pond shore;  sandy shore;  rocky shore
flashcards.definitionZh: 毗邻不流动水体（例如海洋、湖泊或池塘）的土地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 湖岸；  海湾海岸；  海湾沿岸；  岛岸；  大陆海岸；  河岸；  河口岸；  池塘岸边；  沙滩；  岩石海岸

flashcards.definition: A participant in a group of sporting activities which includes track and field, road running, cross country running and racewalking.
flashcards.example: She's the first athlete in her sport to obtain a corporate sponsor.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一组体育活动的参与者，包括田径、公路跑、越野跑和赛跑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她是该运动项目中第一位获得企业赞助的运动员。

flashcards.definition: A popular song released and sold (on any format) nominally on its own though usually having at least one extra track.
flashcards.example: The Offspring released four singles from their most recent album.
flashcards.definitionZh: 名义上单独发行和销售（以任何格式）的流行歌曲，但通常至少有一首额外的曲目。
flashcards.exampleZh: The Offspring 发行了他们最新专辑中的四首单曲。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。

flashcards.example: We had the entire building to ourselves for the evening.
flashcards.exampleZh: 整个晚上我们独享整栋大楼。

flashcards.definition: To contend in physical conflict, either singly or in war, battle etc.
flashcards.example: A wounded animal will fight like a maniac, relentless, savage and murderous.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在身体冲突中进行斗争，无论是单独还是在战争、战斗等中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 受伤的动物会像疯子一样战斗，无情、野蛮和凶残。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.

flashcards.definition: To conduct (oneself) well, or in a given way.
flashcards.example: You need to behave yourself, young lady.
flashcards.definitionZh: 良好地或以某种特定的方式表现（自己）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你需要表现得好一点，年轻的女士。

flashcards.definition: The way a living creature behaves or acts.
flashcards.example: She can't stop the strange behaviour because she has OCD (obsessive-compulsive disorder).
flashcards.exampleZh: 她无法阻止这种奇怪的行为，因为她患有OCD（强迫症）。

flashcards.example: More people today carry a watch on their wrists than in their pockets.
flashcards.definitionZh: 便携式或可穿戴计时器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如今，更多的人将手表戴在手腕上，而不是放在口袋里。

flashcards.definition: A conversation in person (or, by extension, over the telephone, Internet etc.) between a journalist and someone whose opinion or statements he or she wishes to record for publication, broadcast etc.
flashcards.example: The reporter gave the witness an interview.
flashcards.definitionZh: 记者与他或她希望记录其观点或陈述以供出版、广播等的人之间的面对面对话（或者通过电话、互联网等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 记者对目击者进行了采访。

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: To give form or character to; to inspire (with a given quality); to affect, influence (with a pervading principle, idea etc.).
flashcards.example: His sense of religion informs everything he writes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 赋予形式或特征；启发（具有特定的品质）；影响，影响（以普遍的原则、想法等）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的宗教意识贯穿于他所写的一切。

flashcards.definition: A type, race or category; a group of entities that have common characteristics such that they may be grouped together.
flashcards.example: This is a strange kind of tobacco.
flashcards.definitionZh: 类型、种族或类别；一组具有共同特征的实体，因此可以将它们组合在一起。

flashcards.definition: An instance of kind or charitable behaviour.
flashcards.example: How can I thank you for your many kindnesses?
flashcards.definitionZh: 善良或慈善行为的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我该如何感谢您的这么多好意呢？

flashcards.example: He went to a far land.
flashcards.exampleZh: 他去了一个遥远的地方。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.

flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。

flashcards.example: There has been a cutback in federal subsidies. Too, rates have been increasing.
flashcards.exampleZh: 联邦补贴有所削减。利率也一直在上涨。

flashcards.example: We heard a distant rumbling but didn't pay any more attention to it.   She was surprised to find that her fiancé was a distant relative of hers.   His distant look showed that he was not listening to me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 距离很远（身体上、逻辑上或精神上）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们听到远处传来隆隆声，但没有再去注意。   她惊讶地发现，自己的未婚夫竟然是自己的远房亲戚。   他冷漠的表情表明他没有在听我说话。

flashcards.definition: Completely through, right the way through.
An option; a decision; an opportunity to choose or select something.
flashcards.example: Do I have a choice of what color to paint it?
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个选项；决定；选择或选择某事的机会。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我可以选择涂什么颜色吗？

flashcards.definition: An office holder invested with powers and authorities.
flashcards.example: David Barnes was the official charged with the running of the sports club.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拥有权力和权威的官员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大卫·巴恩斯是负责体育俱乐部运营的官员。

flashcards.definition: A religious clergyman (clergywoman, clergyperson) who is trained to perform services or sacrifices at a church or temple
flashcards.example: The Israelite priests were descended from Moses' brother Aaron.
flashcards.definitionZh: 接受过在教堂或寺庙进行服务或祭祀训练的宗教牧师（女牧师、神职人员）
flashcards.exampleZh: 以色列祭司是摩西的兄弟亚伦的后裔。

flashcards.example: A learned local Muslim used to preach in the small mosque every Friday.
flashcards.exampleZh: 当地一位博学的穆斯林每周五都会在小清真寺里传教。

flashcards.definition: A realm, region, or conceptual space where something is dominant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某种事物占主导地位的领域、区域或概念空间。

flashcards.example: I hope this song can unite people from all different cultures.
flashcards.exampleZh: 我希望这首歌能够团结来自不同文化的人们。

flashcards.definition: Characteristic of the North of England (usually capitalised)
flashcards.example: Les Dawson was a famous northern comedian.
flashcards.definitionZh: 英格兰北部的特征（通常大写）
flashcards.exampleZh: 莱斯·道森是一位著名的北方喜剧演员。

flashcards.example: We'll stop at the knife store and look at the sharp pretties.
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们会在刀店停下来看看那些锋利的漂亮东西。

flashcards.definition: Turf grown and cut specifically for the establishment of lawns.
flashcards.example: The landscapers rolled sod onto the bare earth and made a presentable lawn by nightfall.
flashcards.definitionZh: 专门为建立草坪而种植和切割的草皮。
flashcards.exampleZh: 园林设计师在裸露的土地上铺上了草皮，在夜幕降临时打造出了一片漂亮的草坪。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word vlghzd v.

flashcards.definition: A part of a year when something particular happens
flashcards.definitionZh: 一年中某段时间发生特别的事情

flashcards.definition: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.

flashcards.definitionZh: 同一个家庭中的某个人；因血缘、婚姻或收养而有联系的人。

flashcards.definition: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.

flashcards.definitionZh: 同一个家庭中的某个人；因血缘、婚姻或收养而有联系的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为什么我的亲戚总是谈论性？

flashcards.definition: To tell in a descriptive way.
flashcards.example: Please relate the circumstances of your journey here today.
flashcards.exampleZh: 请讲述一下您今天来这里的情况。

flashcards.definition: Something set apart for a special use.
flashcards.definitionZh: 为特殊用途而专门设置的东西。

flashcards.example: He thought he could become a player, at least at the state level.
flashcards.exampleZh: 他认为他可以成为一名球员，至少在州一级。

flashcards.definition: A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.
The passage of a door; a door-shaped entrance into a house or a room.
flashcards.definitionZh: 门的通道；进入房屋或房间的门形入口。

flashcards.example: The battleship had three backwards guns at the stern, in addition to the primary complement.
flashcards.exampleZh: 除了主炮之外，战列舰的船尾还有三门后置炮。

flashcards.definition: Moving or directed toward one side.
flashcards.example: He gave the ball a sideways kick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向一侧移动或指向一侧。

flashcards.definition: Towards a higher place; towards what is above.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向更高的地方迈进；朝着上面的方向。

flashcards.definition: Towards a lower place; towards what is below.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向着较低的地方；朝着下面的方向。
flashcards.exampleZh: 重力将所有东西向下拉。

flashcards.definition: To provoke impatience, anger, or displeasure in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 引起不耐烦、愤怒或不满。

flashcards.definition: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
flashcards.example: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到这样的程度；达到相同的程度或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然做工不太好，但价格却贵了一倍。

flashcards.example: The cage was littered with animal waste
flashcards.exampleZh: 笼子里堆满了动物粪便

flashcards.definition: Dreadful; causing terror, alarm and fear; awesome
flashcards.example: The witch gave him a terrible curse.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可怕;引起恐怖、惊慌和恐惧；惊人的
flashcards.exampleZh: 女巫给了他一个可怕的诅咒。

flashcards.definition: The capacity of someone to lead others.
A gathering of people for the purchase and sale of merchandise at a set time, often periodic.
flashcards.example: The privilege to hold a weekly market was invaluable for any feudal era burgh.
flashcards.definitionZh: 人们在规定的时间（通常是周期性的）聚集在一起购买和销售商品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对于任何封建时代的城镇来说，每周举办一次集市的特权都是无价的。

flashcards.definition: Something that causes amazement or awe; a marvel.
flashcards.example: Wonders of the World seem to come in sevens.
flashcards.definitionZh: 引起惊奇或敬畏的事物；一个奇迹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 世界奇观似乎接二连三。

flashcards.definition: Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive.
flashcards.example: They served a wonderful six-course meal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 出乎意料的优秀；非常好或令人钦佩，非常令人印象深刻。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们提供了一顿美味的六道菜餐。

flashcards.definitionZh: 收获的各种草类粮食作物的种子，例如：小麦、玉米、大麦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们储存了一千吨粮食过冬。

flashcards.example: That is so.  You are responsible for this, is that not so?
flashcards.exampleZh: 是这样的。  你要对此负责，不是吗？

flashcards.example: Just as you would not correct it, neither would I.
flashcards.exampleZh: 正如你不会纠正它一样，我也不会。

flashcards.definition: And not (introducing a negative statement, without necessarily following one).
flashcards.example: Nor did I stop to think, but ran.
flashcards.definitionZh: 而不是（引入否定陈述，不一定遵循否定陈述）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我也没有停下来思考，而是跑了。

flashcards.definition: A piece of metal placed in a horse's mouth and connected to the reins to direct the animal.
flashcards.example: A horse hates having a bit put in its mouth.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放置在马嘴中并连接到缰绳以引导动物的一块金属。
flashcards.exampleZh: 马讨厌把东西放进嘴里。

flashcards.definition: To catch or tear (e.g. fabric) upon a rough surface or projection.

flashcards.definition: A process of choosing a leader, members of parliament, councillors or other representatives by popular vote.

flashcards.definition: The profession of conducting political affairs.

flashcards.definition: A person or thing toward which an emotion is directed.

flashcards.definitionZh: 某人偶然发生的事情，偶然发生的事情，特别是有利的事情。

flashcards.exampleZh: 他迟到了五分钟，但值得赞扬的是，他在轮班结束时确实多工作了十分钟。

flashcards.definition: A person living on adjacent or nearby land; a person situated adjacently or nearby; anything (of the same type of thing as the subject) in an adjacent or nearby position.
flashcards.example: My neighbour has two noisy cats.
flashcards.definitionZh: 居住在邻近或附近土地上的人；位于邻近或附近的人；相邻或附近位置的任何事物（与主题相同类型的事物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的邻居有两只吵闹的猫。

flashcards.definition: In an adjacent building, room or place.
flashcards.example: This is the word Next-door neighbour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在相邻的建筑物、房间或地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“隔壁邻居”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Situated or living nearby or adjacent to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 位于或居住在附近或毗邻。

flashcards.definition: The quality of being a neighbor, of living nearby, next to each-other; proximity.
flashcards.example: Our neighborhood was our only reason to exchange hollow greetings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为邻居、住在附近、彼此毗邻的品质；接近。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的邻居是我们交换空洞问候的唯一理由。

flashcards.word: Get on well or get along well
flashcards.example: I'm going to get a computer tomorrow from the discount store.
flashcards.wordZh: 相处得好还是相处得好
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definition: The state of being well arranged.
flashcards.example: The house is in order; the machinery is out of order.
flashcards.exampleZh: 房子秩序井然；机器出了故障。

flashcards.example: All that remained of his right hand after the accident was a bloody stump.
flashcards.exampleZh: 事故发生后，他的右手只剩下血淋淋的残肢。

flashcards.example: That was a wicked guitar solo, bro!
flashcards.exampleZh: 那是一首邪恶的吉他独奏，兄弟！

flashcards.definition: The quality or condition of being important or worthy of note.
flashcards.definitionZh: 重要或值得注意的品质或状况。

flashcards.definition: (in negative or interrogative constructions) From a given time onwards; longer, again.
flashcards.example: They don't make repairable radios any more.
flashcards.definitionZh: （否定或疑问结构）从给定的时间开始；更长，再一次。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们不再生产可维修的收音机。

flashcards.definition: (in the plural) The practicing members of a religion or followers of a cause.
flashcards.example: The faithful pray five times a day.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数）宗教的信徒或某项事业的追随者。

flashcards.example: Throughout high school she worried that she had a rather plain face.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不是异常美丽；没有吸引力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 整个高中时期，她都担心自己的脸相当平淡。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。

flashcards.definition: A piece of food in the shape of a ring.
A piece of food in the shape of a ring.
To ring many doorbells of (target people or an area) in an effort to contact people and thereby spread information or solicit.
flashcards.example: We doorbelled the whole district in an effort to get out the vote.
flashcards.definitionZh: 敲响（目标人群或某个区域）的许多门铃，以努力联系人们，从而传播信息或招揽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们敲响了整个选区的门铃，试图争取投票。

flashcards.definition: The blow that drives the shuttle, used in calculating the speed of a loom (in picks per minute); hence, in describing the fineness of a fabric, a weft thread.
flashcards.example: so many picks to an inch
flashcards.definitionZh: 驱动梭子的打击，用于计算织布机的速度（以每分钟纬纱为单位）；因此，在描述织物的细度时，用的是纬线。

flashcards.definition: A piece of food in the shape of a ring.
Meaning of the word jhqhudoo vshdnlqj.
flashcards.example: This is the word jhqhudoo vshdnlqj.
flashcards.definitionZh: jhqhudoo vshdnlqj 这个词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是 jhqhudoo vshdnlqj 这个词。

flashcards.example: I was given a command to cease shooting.

flashcards.definition: A structure built or serving as an abode of human beings.
flashcards.example: This is my house and my family's ancestral home.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建造或用作人类住所的建筑物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是我的家，也是我家的祖屋。

flashcards.definition: The locality where a thing is usually found, or was first found, or where it is naturally abundant; habitat; seat.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物通常被发现或首次发现的地方，或者自然丰富的地方；栖息地；座位。

flashcards.example: It is generally known that the Earth is round.

flashcards.definition: Domestic household chores such as cleaning and cooking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 家庭琐事，例如清洁和做饭。

flashcards.definition: The process or an instance of washing or being washed by water or other liquid.
flashcards.example: I'm going to have a quick wash before coming to bed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用水或其他液体清洗或被清洗的过程或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 睡觉前我要快速洗个澡。

flashcards.definition: (plural "housewives") A woman whose main employment is homemaking, maintaining the upkeep of her home and tending to household affairs; often, such a woman whose sole [unpaid] employment is homemaking.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数“家庭主妇”）主要工作是做家务、维护家庭和处理家务的妇女；通常，这样的妇女唯一的[无酬]工作就是做家务。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word xqohvv h fhswli.
flashcards.example: This is the word xqohvv h fhswli.
flashcards.definitionZh: xqohvv h fhswli 一词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是单词 xqohvv h fhswli。

flashcards.definition: (manner) Harshly, severely; in a hard manner.
flashcards.example: I can't really deal hardly with people.
flashcards.definitionZh: （方式）严厉地，严厉地；以一种艰难的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我实在无法与人打交道。

flashcards.definition: The desire to purchase goods and services.
flashcards.example: Prices usually go up when demand exceeds supply.
flashcards.definitionZh: 购买商品和服务的愿望。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当需求超过供应时，价格通常会上涨。

flashcards.definition: A bundle of neurons with their connective tissue sheaths, blood vessels and lymphatics.
flashcards.example: The nerves can be seen through the skin.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一束神经元及其结缔组织鞘、血管和淋巴管。
flashcards.exampleZh: 透过皮肤可以看到神经。

flashcards.definition: A human being, whether man, woman or child.
flashcards.example: Humans share common ancestors with other apes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人，无论是男人、女人还是孩子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 人类与其他猿类有共同的祖先。

flashcards.definition: Involving energy released by nuclear reactions (fission, fusion, radioactive decay).
flashcards.definitionZh: 涉及核反应（裂变、聚变、放射性衰变）释放的能量。

flashcards.definition: Two similar or identical things taken together; often followed by of.
flashcards.example: I couldn't decide which of the pair of designer shirts I preferred, so I bought the pair.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个相似或相同的事物放在一起；后面经常跟着 of。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我无法决定我更喜欢哪一件名牌衬衫，所以我买了这件。

flashcards.definition: A piece of jewelry worn on the ear.

flashcards.example: to paint a portrait or a landscape

flashcards.definition: An object or other creation (e.g. narrative work) from which all later copies and variations are derived
flashcards.definitionZh: 所有后来的副本和变体都源自的物体或其他创作（例如叙事作品）

flashcards.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.
flashcards.example: Time stops for nobody.   the ebb and flow of time
flashcards.definitionZh: 随着现在和过去事件的过去，不可避免地走向未来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 时间为谁停止。   时间的潮起潮落

flashcards.definition: A statement that one sentence is true if another is.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种声明，如果另一个句子为真，则一个句子为真。
flashcards.exampleZh: “A 暗示 B”是一个条件句。

flashcards.definition: A horse that competes in races.
Any of several animals related to Equus ferus caballus.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与马属（Equus ferus caballus）有关的几种动物中的任何一种。

flashcards.definition: A course over which races are run.
A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。

flashcards.definition: Except on a specified condition; if not.
flashcards.example: I’m leaving unless I get a pay rise (AmE: raise).
flashcards.definitionZh: 除非有指定条件；如果不。
flashcards.exampleZh: 除非加薪（AmE：加薪），否则我就会离开。

flashcards.example: After my bout with Guillan-Barre Syndrome, it took me 6 months to be up and about again.
flashcards.exampleZh: 在患上吉兰巴利综合症后，我花了 6 个月的时间才重新站起来走动。

flashcards.definition: The act or result of rolling, or state of being rolled.
flashcards.example: Look at the roll of the waves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 滚动的行为或结果，或被滚动的状态。

flashcards.definition: To move gently back and forth.
To move gently back and forth.

flashcards.example: On a recent windy day, hundreds of visitors climbed wooden stairs to take pictures in front of the glacier.
flashcards.exampleZh: 最近的一个大风天，数百名游客爬上木楼梯在冰川前拍照。

flashcards.definition: The status or condition of something
flashcards.example: The used bookshop wouldn't offer much due to the poor shape of the book.
flashcards.exampleZh: 由于书的形状很差，二手书店不会提供太多东西。

flashcards.definition: A small cup, usually with a handle, used for drinking tea; normally sits in a saucer as part of a tea set.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种小杯子，通常带有把手，用于喝茶；通常作为茶具的一部分放在茶碟中。

flashcards.definition: A concave vessel for drinking from, usually made of opaque material (as opposed to a glass) and with a handle.
flashcards.example: Pour the tea into the cup.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于饮用的凹形容器，通常由不透明材料（而不是玻璃）制成并带有手柄。

flashcards.definition: Belonging to the sex which typically produces sperm, or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
flashcards.example: a male bird feeding a seed to a female
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于通常产生精子的性别，或通常与其相关的性别。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一只雄鸟给雌鸟喂种子

flashcards.definition: Belonging to the sex which typically produces eggs (ova), or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
flashcards.example: female authors, the leading male and female artists, a female bird cooing at a male, intersex female patients, a trans female vlogger
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于通常产生卵子（卵子）的性别，或通常与之相关的性别。
flashcards.exampleZh: 女性作家、领先的男性和女性艺术家、一只对男性咕咕叫的雌鸟、双性女性患者、跨性别女性视频博主

flashcards.definition: A division, a portion, a share.
flashcards.example: We gave three deals of grain in tribute to the king.
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们向国王进贡了三笔粮食。
这就是“有利可图”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who lives near a given place.
flashcards.example: It's easy to tell the locals from the tourists.
flashcards.definitionZh: 住在某个地方附近的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 很容易区分当地人和游客。

flashcards.definition: A metal rod, generally of wrought iron, for adjusting the burning logs or coals in a fire; a firestick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 金属棒，通常由锻铁制成，用于调节火中燃烧的原木或煤炭；一根火棒。

flashcards.definition: One who conducts the business of banking; one who, individually, or as a member of a company, keeps an establishment for the deposit or loan of money, or for traffic in money, bills of exchange, etc.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从事银行业务的人；个人或作为公司成员开设存款或贷款机构，或进行货币、汇票等交易的人。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: Connects at least two alternative words, phrases, clauses, sentences, etc. each of which could make a passage true. In English, this is the "inclusive or." The "exclusive or" is formed by "either [...] or".
flashcards.example: He might get cancer, or be hit by a bus, or God knows what.
flashcards.definitionZh: 连接至少两个替代单词、短语、从句、句子等，其中每一个都可以使段落正确。在英语中，这就是“包含或”。 “异或”由“或者[...]或”构成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他可能会得癌症，或者被公共汽车撞到，或者天知道会发生什么。

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。

flashcards.definition: An actual event, situation, or fact.
flashcards.example: For a change, in this case, he was telling the truth.
flashcards.exampleZh: 相比之下，在这种情况下，他说的是实话。

flashcards.example: The Commander says we will make our stand here.
flashcards.exampleZh: 指挥官说我们会坚守在这里。

flashcards.example: This latest discovery should eventually lead to much better treatments for disease.
flashcards.exampleZh: 这一最新发现最终应该会带来更好的疾病治疗方法。

flashcards.wordZh: 落下停留定居清算解决决定

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word qlwhg dwlrqv.
flashcards.example: This is the word qlwhg dwlrqv.
flashcards.definitionZh: qlwhg dwlrqv 这个词的含义。

flashcards.definition: To place or arrange in(to) a desired (especially: calm) state, or make final disposition of (something).
flashcards.definitionZh: 将（某事）放置或安排成所需的（尤其是：平静的）状态，或做出最终的处置。

flashcards.definition: To be or to put into a state of rest.
flashcards.example: I shall not rest until I have uncovered the truth.
flashcards.exampleZh: 在揭露真相之前我不会休息。

flashcards.example: Don't unsettle the horses or they'll bolt.
flashcards.exampleZh: 不要惊动马，否则它们会逃跑。

flashcards.example: I haven't seen him in forever!
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经很久没见过他了！

flashcards.definition: The act or result of stirring (moving around the particles of a liquid etc.)
flashcards.example: Can you give the soup a little stir?
flashcards.definitionZh: 搅拌的行为或结果（在液体颗粒周围移动等）
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能稍微搅拌一下汤吗？

flashcards.example: I hope this song can unite people from all different cultures.
flashcards.exampleZh: 我希望这首歌能够团结来自不同文化的人们。

flashcards.definition: To move from further away to nearer to.
flashcards.example: She’ll be coming ’round the mountain when she comes [...]
flashcards.definitionZh: 从较远的地方移动到较近的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当她来时，她会绕山而来[...]

flashcards.definition: In part, or to some degree, but not completely.
flashcards.example: they partly finished the house so they could move in before winter;  the car was partly visible in the garage
flashcards.definitionZh: 部分地，或在某种程度上，但不完全。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们部分完成了房子，这样他们就可以在冬天之前搬进去；  车库里的汽车部分可见

flashcards.definition: To encounter with courage and fortitude, to defy, to provoke.
flashcards.example: After braving tricks on the high-dive, he braved a jump off the first diving platform.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以勇气和毅力去面对、反抗、挑衅。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在完成了高位跳水的技巧后，他勇敢地从第一个跳台上跳了下来。

flashcards.definition: A tabletop container for pens and stationery.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于放置钢笔和文具的桌面容器。

flashcards.example: Completion of an identifiable stage of maintenance such as removing an aircraft engine for repair or storage.
flashcards.exampleZh: 完成可识别的维护阶段，例如拆除飞机发动机进行修理或存放。

flashcards.definition: To arrange, in the manner of a broker.
flashcards.example: Central banks need to regulate the entities that intermediate monetary transactions.
flashcards.exampleZh: 中央银行需要监管货币交易中介实体。

flashcards.definition: A thin connected passing of a liquid through a lighter gas (e.g. air).
flashcards.example: He poured the milk in a thin stream from the jug to the glass.
flashcards.definitionZh: 液体通过较轻的气体（例如空气）的稀薄连接。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他把牛奶从罐子里细细地倒到玻璃杯里。

flashcards.definition: (open-source software) To have (a software library, patch, etc.) accepted by the original developers of the related software, so that they maintain and distribute it.
flashcards.example: I'd be more than happy to upstream your patch.
flashcards.definitionZh: （开源软件）让相关软件的原始开发者接受（软件库、补丁等），以便他们维护和分发它。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我非常乐意将您的补丁上传到上游。

flashcards.definition: Lower down, in relation to a river, stream or flow of fluid
flashcards.example: She lives downstream from the dam.
flashcards.definitionZh: 较低，相对于河流、溪流或流体流动

flashcards.definition: To determine with precision; to mark out with distinctness; to ascertain or exhibit clearly.
flashcards.example: the defining power of an optical instrument
flashcards.definitionZh: 精确地确定；清楚地标出；明确地确定或展示。

flashcards.definition: To move back and forth repeatedly and somewhat loosely.
flashcards.example: The flag waved in the gentle breeze.
flashcards.definitionZh: 反复地、稍微宽松地来回移动。

flashcards.definition: The amount of space between two points, usually geographical points, usually (but not necessarily) measured along a straight line.
flashcards.example: From Moscow, the distance is relatively short to Saint Petersburg, relatively long to Novosibirsk, but even greater to Vladivostok.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两点（通常是地理点）之间的空间量，通常（但不一定）沿直线测量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从莫斯科到圣彼得堡的距离相对较短，到新西伯利亚的距离相对较长，但到符拉迪沃斯托克的距离则更长。

flashcards.definition: Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than)
flashcards.example: I'd like this one rather than the other one.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于指定选择或偏好；优选地，优先于。 （现在通常后面接比）
flashcards.exampleZh: 我想要这个而不是另一个。

flashcards.definition: To bestow commendation on; to represent favourably; to suggest, endorse or encourage as an appropriate choice.
flashcards.example: The board recommends Philips, given his ample experience in similar positions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 给予表扬；积极代表；建议、认可或鼓励作为适当的选择。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鉴于飞利浦在类似职位上的丰富经验，董事会推荐飞利浦。

flashcards.definition: A unit of mass equal to one-thousandth of a kilogram. Symbol: g
flashcards.definitionZh: 质量单位，等于千分之一千克。符号：g

flashcards.definition: Any of various units of currency formerly used in the United States.
flashcards.example: the Rhode Island pound; the New Hampshire pound
flashcards.definitionZh: 以前在美国使用的任何各种货币单位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗德岛镑；新罕布什尔镑

flashcards.definition: To wound or cause physical harm to a living creature.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对生物造成伤害或造成身体伤害。

flashcards.definition: Damage to the body of a human or animal.
flashcards.example: The passenger sustained a severe injury in the car accident.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对人类或动物的身体造成损害。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这名乘客在车祸中受重伤。

flashcards.definition: A hurt to a person's feelings, reputation, prospects, etc.
flashcards.example: It took a long time to get over the wound of that insult.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对一个人的感情、名誉、前景等的伤害。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我花了很长时间才从那次侮辱的创伤中恢复过来。

flashcards.example: The wool on my arm produced a strange feeling.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感觉，尤其是通过皮肤的感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 手臂上的羊毛产生了一种奇怪的感觉。

flashcards.definition: Genuine; meaning what one says or does; heartfelt.
flashcards.example: I believe he is sincere in his offer to help.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真的;指一个人所说或所做的事；衷心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我相信他是真诚地愿意提供帮助。

flashcards.definition: Done by design or intention; intentional.
flashcards.example: If a man accidentally kills another by lopping a tree, it is not voluntary manslaughter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 按设计或意图完成；故意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果一个人砍伐一棵树时意外杀死了另一个人，则不属于故意杀人。

flashcards.definition: To divide (a thing) into separate parts.
flashcards.example: Separate the articles from the headings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将（事物）分成单独的部分。

flashcards.example: My cousin is such a dear, always drawing me pictures.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个非常善良、有爱心的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的表弟很可爱，总是给我画画。

flashcards.example: I have been faithfully married for the past twenty years.
flashcards.exampleZh: 在过去的二十年里，我一直忠实地结婚。

flashcards.definition: In a sincere or earnest manner; honestly.
flashcards.example: I sincerely hope they make it home safely.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以真诚或认真的方式；诚实地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我衷心希望他们能够平安回家。

flashcards.definition: The worth or estimation in which something or someone is held.
flashcards.example: He is held in great regard in Whitehall.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物或某人的价值或估计。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在白厅受到高度尊重。

flashcards.definition: To provide a list of references for (a text).
flashcards.example: You must thoroughly reference your paper before submitting it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提供（文本）的参考文献列表。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在提交之前，您必须彻底参考您的论文。

flashcards.definition: Along, together with others, in a group, etc.
flashcards.example: Do you want to come with?
flashcards.definitionZh: 一起、与他人一起、在一个团体中等等。

flashcards.definition: The abstract instantiation of goodness; that which possesses desirable qualities, promotes success, welfare, or happiness, is serviceable, fit, excellent, kind, benevolent, etc.
flashcards.example: The best is the enemy of the good.
flashcards.definitionZh: 善的抽象实例化；拥有理想品质、促进成功、福利或幸福的东西是有用的、适合的、优秀的、善良的、仁慈的，等等。

flashcards.example: He cancelled his order on their website.
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在他们的网站上取消了订单。

flashcards.example: If the camera is faulty, you can return it to the store where you bought it for a full refund.
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果相机出现故障，您可以将其退回购买相机的商店以获得全额退款。

flashcards.example: Environmental protection is a condition for sustainability.   What other planets might have the right conditions for life?   The union had a dispute over sick time and other conditions of employment.
flashcards.exampleZh: 环境保护是可持续发展的条件。   还有哪些行星可能具备适合生命存在的条件？   工会在病假和其他就业条件方面存在争议。

flashcards.definition: A blow or application of physical force against something.
flashcards.example: Thus hand strikes now include single knuckle strikes, knife hand strikes, finger strikes, ridge hand strikes etc., and leg strikes include front kicks, knee strikes, axe kicks, ...
flashcards.definitionZh: 对某物的打击或使用物理力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 因此，手击现在包括单指击、刀手击、指击、脊手击等，腿击包括前踢、膝击、斧踢……

flashcards.definition: A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.
flashcards.example: ram a post into the ground
flashcards.definitionZh: 从地面伸出的长销钉或木板；栅栏柱；一根灯柱。

flashcards.example: ram a post into the ground
flashcards.definitionZh: 从地面伸出的长销钉或木板；栅栏柱；一根灯柱。

flashcards.definition: A box in which post can be left by a sender to be picked up by a courier or postman (postal worker).
flashcards.example: Would you take these letters down to the post box please – they've already got stamps.
flashcards.definitionZh: 寄件人可以将邮件留在其中并由快递员或邮递员（邮政工作人员）领取的箱子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请您把这些信带到邮箱里好吗？它们已经贴上了邮票。

flashcards.example: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
flashcards.exampleZh: 英文字母表中有二十六个字母。

flashcards.example: He managed to climb the tower.

flashcards.definition: (computer software) A window or application whose purpose is to give the user the control over some aspect of the system.
flashcards.example: a file manager; a task manager; Program Manager
flashcards.definitionZh: （计算机软件）一种窗口或应用程序，其目的是让用户控制系统的某些方面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 文件管理器；任务管理器；项目经理

flashcards.definition: The quality of being (especially visually) attractive, pleasing, fine or good-looking; comeliness.
flashcards.example: 1988, "… beauty and recollection, like danger, glamour, greed, hunger- everything but disappointment and desire- were concepts belonging to other people.” -Second Son, Robert Ferro
flashcards.definitionZh: （尤其是视觉上）有吸引力、令人愉悦、精致或好看的品质；美丽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1988年，“……美丽和回忆，就像危险、魅力、贪婪、饥饿一样——除了失望和欲望之外的一切——都是属于别人的概念。” -次子，罗伯特·费罗

flashcards.definition: A grain or seed, especially of a cereal crop.
flashcards.example: He paid her the nominal fee of two corns of barley.
flashcards.definitionZh: 谷物或种子，尤指谷类作物的谷物或种子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他象征性地付给她两粒大麦的费用。

flashcards.example: Which cereal would you like for breakfast?

flashcards.definition: Any plant regarded as unwanted at the place where, and at the time when it is growing.
flashcards.example: If it isn't in a straight line or marked with a label, it's a weed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何在其生长地点和生长时间被视为不需要的植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果它不是在一条直线上或没有标记，那就是杂草。
